optimizePanel.title: Aim optimization
optimizePanel.selectCameraHint: Select a camera to optimize it on its own, or optimize the whole scene.
optimizePanel.cameraDisabledHint: {{name}} is disabled; enable it to optimize its aim.
optimizePanel.aimLockedHint: {{name}} has its aim locked (uncheck it in the camera panel).
optimizePanel.optimizeOneHint: Optimizing one camera captures what it could see and shows a score map for every aim.
optimizePanel.yawPitchHint: Yaw −180…180° left to right, pitch +89…−89° top to bottom. Click to pick an aim.
optimizePanel.noImprovementHint: No improvement found — the camera is already near its best aim. Click the map to aim it somewhere else anyway.
optimizePanel.noCameraImprovedHint: No camera improved by more than {{percent}}% over the counted set. Select a camera to see its score map and aim it by hand.
optimizePanel.regressedWarning_one: {{count}} zone lost coverage. Maximizing unique coverage can trade one zone for another; lock or re-aim the cameras that cover them.
optimizePanel.regressedWarning_other: {{count}} zones lost coverage. Maximizing unique coverage can trade one zone for another; lock or re-aim the cameras that cover them.
optimizePanel.noZonesHint: No sampling zones — the row above is the whole valid volume.
